reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: lines 274-276 iterate over cellsAndProofs.len while line 281 assigns all blob_kzg_commitments without validating length equality. Spec cross-reference: 01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json contains PROP-57888860-pre-007 requiring 'len(cells_and_kzg_proofs) == len(kzg_commitments)'. The subgraph SG-003 (fulu-validator/get_data_column_sidecars.mmd line 8) explicitly shows 'q_assert: assert len(cells_and_kzg_proofs) == len(kzg_commitments)' as the first validation step. The implementation omits this required assertion, creating potential for sidecars with mismatched commitments and cell data. Severity justified: Nimbus has ~8-10% network share, exceeding Medium threshold (>5%) but below High threshold (>33%).
